'''P4 sp. z o.o.''', known as '''Play''' (until January 2022, also as '''Play Communications SA''', former parent company of P4 registered in [[Luxembourg]]), is a Polish [[telecommunication]]s company. Play was founded as a [[mobile telephony]] operator in 2007 and has gradually increased its local market share in mobile, up to 27% {{as of|2017|lc=yes}}.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ft.com/content/68c8de40-54db-11e7-80b6-9bfa4c1f83d2|title=Poland's Play to float in Europe's largest telecoms IPO for 5 years|newspaper=Financial Times|access-date=2019-10-03|url-access=subscription}}</ref> In September 2020, Play became part of French [[Iliad SA|Iliad]].<ref>{{Cite news|last1=Fouquet|first=Helene|last2=Martewicz|first2=Maciej|date=2020-09-21|title=Iliad Agrees to Buy Poland's Play in 2.2 Billion-Euro Deal|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-09-21/iliad-agrees-to-buy-poland-s-play-in-2-2-billion-euro-deal|access-date=2020-10-15|website=Bloomberg}}</ref> Before being sold, Iceland's [[Novator Partners]], led by Icelandic businessman [[Thor Bjorgolfsson]], acquired a large stake in the company.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ft.com/content/14a9b966-c71f-11e4-8e1f-00144feab7de|title=Monday interview: Thor Bjorgolfsson, investor|date=2015-03-29|newspaper=Financial Times|url-access=subscription}}</ref> As of November 20, 2020, [[Iliad SA|Iliad]] owns 96.66% of Play.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.playcommunications.com/current-reports/2020/361/43-2020-summary-of-the-tender-offer-for-the-acquisition-of-shares-of-play-communications-s-a|title=Summary of the Tender Offer for the acquisition of shares of Play Communications S.A.|date=2020-11-25|access-date=2020-11-25}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://iliad-strapi.s3.fr-par.scw.cloud/CP_201120_Eng_d5d3df9ec7.pdf|format=pdf|title=iliad's friendly public tender offer for the Polish telecom operator, Play, is a success, with iliad now holding 96.7% of Play's capital and voting rights|date=2020-11-20|access-date=2020-11-20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|language=pl|url=https://biuroprasowe.play.pl/aktualnosci/570323/zarzad-play-przyjmuje-oferte-przejecia-100-akcji-play-communications-sa-przez-grupe-iliad|title=Zarząd PLAY przyjmuje ofertę przejęcia 100% akcji Play Communications SA przez Grupę iliad|date=2020-09-21|access-date=2020-11-20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.playcommunications.com/current-reports/2020/365/45-2020-notification-of-transactions-related-to-major-shareholdings|title=Notification of transactions related to major shareholdings|date=2020-11-27|access-date=2020-11-27}}</ref>

On August 31, 2023, [[UPC Polska|UPC Poland]] merged with Play after Iliad acquired the company from Liberty Global to become a full-service telecommunications provider.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.broadbandtvnews.com/2023/08/31/upc-becomes-play-in-poland/|title=UPC becomes Play in Poland|website=broadbandtvnews.com|access-date=31 August 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://developingtelecoms.com/telecom-technology/optical-fixed-networks/13293-iliad-completes-upc-poland-acquisition.html|title=Iliad completes UPC Poland acquisition|website=developingtelecoms.com|access-date=5 April 2022}}</ref>

==Network==
{{Section rewrite |date= August 2026}}
As of 2026, Play is the second biggest cellular network in Poland with over 13.6 million customers behind only [[Orange Polska]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Orange nadal z największą liczbą klientów po 2Q/2026 |url=https://www.my-mobile.pl/index.php/2026/10/01/orange-play-plus-t-mobile-liczba-klientow-wyniki-finansowe-2q-2026/ |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=www.my-mobile.pl}}</ref> PLAY uses EGSM 900 and GSM1800 for its 2G services, UMTS 2100 and UMTS 900 for 3G and LTE700<ref>{{Cite web |title=Uruchamiamy stacje bazowe w paśmie 700 MHz – oznacza to jeszcze lepszy zasięg i jakość usług dla naszych klientów |url=https://www.play.pl/play-expert/newsy/uruchamiamy-stacje-bazowe-w-pasmie-700-mhz---oznacza-to-jeszcze-lepszy-zasieg-i-jakosc-uslug-dla-naszych-klientow |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=www.play.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>, LTE800, LTE900 LTE1800, LTE2100 and LTE 2600 for LTE. Its MCC is 260–06.

===Native Network===
As of November 3, 2013, Play Mobile has 3288 EGSM 900 BTS, 4143 UMTS 2100 nodeB and 2175 UMTS 900 nodeB's. UMTS 900 and UMTS 2100 network Play calls the 4G network. Currently, 82% of population is covered with Play's native 4G network and 40% of the population with 2G network. 4G is available in more than 300 cities and towns around Poland. Play started building its 3G network at the beginning of its existence (2007) and announced that its goal is to cover all of Poland with UMTS while provide GSM services through roaming. Play began building its GSM network in March 2009 in apparent bid to reduce roaming costs. EGSM 900 BTS and UMTS 900 nodeB use the same licence frequency. In place when are EGSM 900 usually is not UMTS 900.
Play Mobile Broadband (Play Online) products did not use 2G network.

On February 13, 2013 the company won the tender for the frequency of 1800&nbsp;MHz.<ref name="uke1800przetarg">{{cite web | url=http://uke.gov.pl/wyniki-przetargu-na-czestotliwosci-1800-mhz-12082 | title=Wyniki przetargu na częstotliwości 1800 MHz | publisher=Urząd Komunikacji Elektronicznej (Office of Electronic Communications) | date=2013-02-13 | access-date=2013-03-14 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130429122059/http://uke.gov.pl/wyniki-przetargu-na-czestotliwosci-1800-mhz-12082 | archive-date=2013-04-29 | url-status=dead }}</ref> On February 19, 2013, Play filed in the Office of Electronic Communications applications for booking three blocks from the frequency band 1800&nbsp;MHz.<ref name="playrezerwacja">{{cite web | url=http://www.blogplay.pl/2013/02/play-zlozyl-wnioski-o-rezerwacje-trzech-blokow-czestotliwosci-sorki-orange/ | title=PLAY złożył wnioski o rezerwację trzech bloków częstotliwości – sorki Orange ;-) | publisher=blogplay.pl | date=2013-02-19 }}</ref> The new frequency will be used probably for to build LTE network or shared network (LTE and DCS).

===Roaming===
On September 6, 2006 Play signed a domestic roaming agreement with [[Plus (telecommunications Poland)|Plus]] operator - Polkomtel.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.money.pl/gielda/wiadomosci/artykul/play-wypowiedzial-umowe-roamingu-krajowego,106,0,2424682.html |language=pl |title=Play wypowiedział umowę roamingu krajowego Polkomtelowi |website=money.pl |date=21 December 2018 |access-date=6 April 2023}}</ref> It allowed Play subscribers to access Plus' GSM network as well as UMTS network. Roaming was nationwide, free and unlimited. In addition, Play subscribers could manually pick Plus GSM network despite presence of Play's native network. In October 2018, Play started phasing this possibility out.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-10-12 |title=Play zapowiada koniec roamingu krajowego. Poznań straci dostęp do zasięgu 4 sieci jako pierwszy |url=https://spidersweb.pl/2018/10/play-roaming-krajowy-poznan.html |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=Spider's Web |language=pl}}</ref> In December, Play has announced they are withdrawing the contract with Polkomtel by 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-12-24 |title=Play rezygnuje z roamingu krajowego od Polkomtelu. Stawia na własną sieć oraz współpracę z Orange i T-Mobile |url=https://www.wirtualnemedia.pl/artykul/play-roaming-krajowy-od-polkomtel-koniec-dalej-wspolpracuje-z-orange-i-t-mobile |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=www.wirtualnemedia.pl |language=pl}}</ref>

In July 2010, Play signed a domestic roaming agreement with [[Orange Polska|Orange]] operator - Centertel.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://gomobi.pl/news/orange-i-play-zawarli-umowe-o-roamingu/ |language=pl |title=Orange i Play zawarli umowę o roamingu |website=gomobi.pl |author=Łukasz Kłosowski |date=28 November 2011 |access-date=6 April 2023}}</ref> The initial agreement included a limited territorial coverage. In November 2011, Play and Orange signed an annex to the agreement, expanding the coverage of the whole Polish territory.<ref name="wplaydowyboruaztrzysieci">{{cite web | url=http://www.blogplay.pl/2011/11/w-play-do-wyboru-az-trzy-sieci/ | title=W PLAY do wyboru aż trzy sieci! | publisher=blogplay.pl | date=2011-11-28 }}</ref> However, Plus and Orange domestic network could not be used with Play's Mobile Broadband products. In 2021, Orange has announced a new contract with Play, extending domestic roaming until 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-08-06 |title=Play bez roamingu krajowego? Nie tak szybko, P4 przedłuża umowę z Orange Polska |url=https://www.telepolis.pl/wiadomosci/prawo-finanse-statystyki/play-bez-roamingu-krajowego-nie-tak-szybko-p4-przedluza-umowe-z-orange-polska |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=www.telepolis.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

During the Mobile World Congress 2013 in Barcelona Play announced that the third domestic roaming partner will be [[T-Mobile (Poland)|T-Mobile]] operator - PTC.<ref name="kierunekrozwojubranzynowasiec">{{cite web | url=http://www.blogplay.pl/2013/02/play-w-2012-roku-wyznaczylismy-nowy-kierunek-rozwoju-branzy// | title=PLAY: w 2012 roku wyznaczyliśmy nowy kierunek rozwoju branży | publisher=blogplay.pl | date=2013-02-26 }}</ref> Agreement with T-Mobile has expired at the end of 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-12-27 |title=Play wyłącza roaming krajowy w T-Mobile |url=https://www.telepolis.pl/wiadomosci/taryfy-promocje-uslugi/play-roaming-krajowy-t-mobile-koniec |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=www.telepolis.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref>

In 2017, Play started requiring users to enable domestic roaming, with roaming with only one operator enabled at a time.<ref>{{Cite web |last=GSMONLINE.PL |title=PLAY zmienił konfigurację roamingu krajowego |url=https://gsmonline.pl/artykuly/play-roaming-krajowy-co-sie-zmienilo |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=GSMONLINE.PL |language=en}}</ref>

In 2025, Play terminated its domestic roaming agreement with Orange, as its network range had become sufficient to eliminate the need for such service.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Play odcina się od Orange? Własne nadajniki powinny wystarczyć |url=https://www.telepolis.pl/artykuly/felietony/play-orange-roaming-krajowy-koniec-umowy-co-dalej |access-date=2026-10-27 |website=www.telepolis.pl |language=pl-PL}}</ref> 

[[Virgin Mobile Polska|Virgin Mobile Poland]] is using the Play network (including Orange network, excluding Plus network).<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://komorkomania.pl/virgin-mobile-przejete-przez-siec-play-co-to-oznacza-dla-klientow,6779817750837377a |language=pl |title=Virgin Mobile przejęte przez sieć Play. Co to oznacza dla klientów? |website=komorkomania.pl |date=23 April 2020 |access-date=6 April 2023}}</ref>

== IPO ==
In July 2017 the company was offered to the public and listed on the [[Warsaw Stock Exchange]], with plans to raise €1.03bn from its first IPO.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ft.com/content/1df7f5bc-685f-11e7-8526-7b38dcaef614|title=Poland's Play finalises €1bn IPO at low end of range|website=Financial Times|language=en-GB|access-date=2019-10-03}}</ref>
